name: Gasthof Oberstegen
beschreibung:
Idyllically set on the outskirts of Soell, Gasthof Oberstegen features a friendly family environment with comfortable rooms. Homemade dishes provide energy for active days on the Wilder Kaiser.

Access to the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser - Brixental network and scenic trails are right nearby.
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthof Oberstegen in Soell offers restful accommodation and regional cooking at the foot of the Kaiser mountains.
